description: Average residential, commercial, and industrial electric utility rates (cents per kWh) for a location, plus the utility name. Used for ROI analysis on solar, EV charging, building electrification.

address.description: Street address, city/state, or place name. Either address OR lat+lon required.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Use with lon as alternative to address.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. Use with lat as alternative to address.

name: nrel_utility_rates
